messages:
Maya Chen: heads-up — last night eu-west shared pool hit sustained 95% GPU_util for ~40min, causing p99 token latency spikes. telemetry linked: https://redwood.internal/gfx/ops/evt/2071005678
Samir Patel: saw the alert. root cause looks like multiple tenants with large regen loops + big batch sizes. noisy-tenant detection didn't kick in quickly enough.
Priya Nair: are these Dedicated tenants or shared? any cross-region failover?
Maya Chen: shared pool eu-west-1. some tenants on dedicated weren't affected. suspected network egress spikes from tenant "ad-db-analytics" overloaded NVMe I/O and forced queuing.
Igor Kovalev: NVMe I/O? can we confirm with node metrics? iostat shows write latency spike correlating.
Alex R.: kube logs show some pod OOM and transient restarts, but not full evictions. deploy-bot: elastalert: GPU_util > 90% for 2400s in cluster eu-west-1/gpu-pool-3
Samir Patel: proposal: introduce a "gradual pressure" admission gate — when pool_util > 80% for 2m, start applying per-tenant concurrency cap reduction (-20%) and prefer smaller batch sizes. fallback: escalate to soft-eviction if > 92% for 5m.
Priya Nair: nice. need to tune thresholds to avoid ping-pong. suggest we test with canary tenants and metric-driven rollouts.
Maya Chen: experiment plan:
```
- target: gpu-pool-3 eu-west-1
- criteria: pool_util >= 80% for 2m -> step-1 cap -20%
- step-2: pool_util >= 92% for 5m -> soft-evict top noisy tenants by score
- rollback: restore after pool_util < 70% for 3m
```
Samir Patel: also add per-tenant "cost signal" so we bias throttles for heavy-cost tenants first (reduce QoS for high-cost, low-SLA).
Priya Nair: how to compute noisy score? combine qps, long-sessions, kv-cache-miss-rate, disk-io. weight = 0.4*qps + 0.3*long_sessions + 0.2*cache_miss + 0.1*disk_io
Igor Kovalev: can we avoid evictions for latency-sensitive tenants (tier=SLA1)? mark tenants with SLA1 exempt from eviction but allow cap reductions.
Alex R.: one more risk: cross-region traffic surge if we start moving tenants; prefer local admission control vs placement churn.
Maya Chen: timeline: run canary 24h with two tenants, collect p95/p99, cost delta, eviction rate. I'll open a deploy PR after design signoff.
Samir Patel: +1 from me. @Priya help define observability dashboard (token counts, qps, score distribution).
Priya Nair: on it. will add alert thresholds and a notebook for simulation.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: experiment/gpu-pressure-gate -> 2 canaries in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-22T02:00Z :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks all. follow-ups: assign owners and link runbook updates. :thumbsup:
